Career Journey

An accomplished Mechanical Engineering alumnus of BUET's Class of 1983, Mirza — known to batchmates as Shohag — went on to build an impressive set of credentials in Canada even in the later years of his career, a quiet reminder that the pursuit of growth has no expiry date. He brings extensive hands-on experience in industrial refrigeration and plant operations, currently serving as Shift Engineer at Drennan Refrigeration Inc. in Ontario, Canada.
